fact: Statistics Mauritius released online on 27 June 2025 the eighteenth Economic and Social Indicators issue on Crime, Justice and Security for 2024, based on administrative data from the Mauritius Police Force, the Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions, the Judiciary, the Mauritius Prison Service and the Probation and After Care Service (source records of five bodies; Issue 1864, Year 2024 edition, previous edition Year 2023).
title: Economic and Social Indicators: Crime, Justice and Security, Year 2024 (Issue 1864)
